about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One new Proofline task, XC-38, for R20c: a retry that re-signs a payment under the same payment-identifier id. XC-38 was reserved for this check in docs/ROADMAP.md and never used. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. The task becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. It builds on XC-22 (R20, R20a, R20b), which is signed and done. Every criterion except scope and pushed fails on today's tree and passes only on committed code, tests and docs. Estimated effort: 2-3 days.

tasks.title: R20c: a same-id re-signed retry is graded as a safe refusal

on_lapse: reassign to the next free agent

tasks.description: The client times out before /settle answers and retries with a newly signed payment under the same payment-identifier id. The payment-identifier extension lets a server refuse a request whose id it has already seen with a different payload; the upstream payment-identifier example answers 409 here, and R20a grades that as a failure today. R20c grades it: it passes when the server either refuses the re-signed retry with a clear 409 (or another 4xx naming the id) and settles nothing a second time, or returns the original result without a second settle. It fails when the re-signed retry is settled. Same harness as R20a and R20b (ts/src/retry.ts, real @x402/express servers behind the double), with the control and one faulty build, wired into the CLI --retry run, the JSON, SARIF and JUnit reports, docs/SPEC.md, docs/FIXES.md and CHANGELOG.md. Assumption, not stated in the issue: whether R20a keeps failing a 409-refusing server or leaves that case to R20c is decided at build time and written in docs/FIXES.md.
tasks.evidence_required: The merged PR, the CI run on main where every criterion passes, and the vv strict receipt that claims XC-38.
